title: SOW builder (April 2026)
description: A series of questions for solution engineers to pose to prospects with a view to generating an SOW to be shared internally and externally.

questions.text: How would you best describe their business?
questions.supportingDetails: Consider what industry they operate within to see if this prospects fits with our ICP.

questions.text: Which countries do they currently process in?
questions.supportingDetails: If ALL countries are supported, select a few and enter "All" in the comments section.

answers.text: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

questions.text: Which payment methods do they currently accept?
questions.supportingDetails: Remember some payment methods are only available in certain geographies; if "Other", please use the comments space to record in a comma separated list.

questions.text: Which payment methods do they plan to accept?
questions.supportingDetails: If "Other", please use the comments space to record in a comma separated list.

questions.text: Which processors do they currently use?
questions.supportingDetails: If "Other", list each separated by a comma.

Which currencies are accepted?
Which currencies do they settle in?
What platform can their customers use to perform a purchase?
questions.supportingDetails: If the checkout in a mobile app is rendered using a web container (e.g. Chrome Custom Tab or ASWebAuthenticationSession), consider this as "Web".

questions.text: How are their Android apps built?
How are their iOS apps built?
At what stage of their journey can a customer make a purchase?
How are shipping related options managed?
questions.supportingDetails: Consider - is there a flat fee or is it dynamically calculated?

questions.text: Are payment methods saved?
As payment methods are saved, select appropriate use case(s)
questions.supportingDetails: If used for "subscription payments", call out how they plan to manage this.

questions.text: Are there any tokens that need to be imported?
How many in total?
questions.supportingDetails: Use the comments space to detail where tokens need to be imported from and if we need to consider transforming customer IDs.

questions.text: Are any 3D secure exemptions used?
Which exemptions are actively employed?
Are Network Tokens in use?
On average, how many payments per second do they expect to process during their peak season?
questions.supportingDetails: Record the periods where the spike is observed in the comments field.

questions.text: How are fraudulent payment attempts prevented?
questions.supportingDetails: If internal tool, document if web request app could be applicable or not.

questions.text: Which third-party tool is used?
questions.supportingDetails: If "Other", please specify in comments. Also, list the third-party functions that are used.
